source.note: Recorded before successor behavior, from a clean checkout; ordinary Normal birch world (arrivals on), 12000 ticks including a generated watch ask (a probe of this checkout, sampling every 200 ticks, recorded the first at tick 8600), then 120 more after a save and load. The same probe ran forest, birch, meadow, river, aspen and cedar to 72000 ticks and made no watch request: every nearby adult had already seen the child.
